# 13.2 notes: the War Story closes on the Fleet Manager hand check

## Context

The 13.2 notes' War Story, "green in emulation, broken by hand", lists every repair a hand check on real windows found before the cut. The operator's last hand check (#14800, 2026-10-11 ~18:40Z), in the installed Fleet Manager, found one more. A header-action pop-out dragged by its title bar over the main app painted no drop zones. #19622 (resolves #19619) repairs it in the engine: the dock now loads `WindowPosition` into each window it arms whenever its App Worker is a SharedWorker.

## The Problem

The notes end that story one repair short, and the repair changes what an adopter configures: a tear-out app no longer lists the addon.

## The Fix

One paragraph after the War Story's "fourth repair": the symptom, the cause (the addon was armed only where an app listed it; the Fleet Manager listed none, and its popups run a child app with its own config) and the repair, linking #19622. Scope: `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.2.0.md` only.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 The paragraph states only what #19619/#19622 and the operator's report establish.
- [ ] AC-2 The release-note link guard passes.

## Out of Scope

The engine change (#19622), the Fleet Manager rebuild, Ada's #19625.

## Related

#14800, #19619, #19622, #19604.
